sentences.en: From The New York Times, this is The Interview.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，这里是《访谈》。

sentences.en: I'm Lulu Garcia Navarro.
sentences.zh: 我是露露·加西亚-纳瓦罗。

sentences.en: I don't know quite what I was expecting when I walked into Simon Cowell's home in southwest
sentences.zh: 当我走进西蒙·考威尔位于伦敦西南部时，我不知道自己到底期待什么，

sentences.en: London, but I was greeted by endless cups of tea, a warm welcome from his longtime partner
sentences.zh: 但迎面而来的是无尽的茶水、他长期伴侣劳伦的热烈欢迎，

sentences.en: Lauren, and his 11-year-old son Eric.
sentences.zh: 以及他11岁的儿子埃里克。

sentences.en: Cal was also pretty charming.
sentences.zh: 卡尔也相当迷人。

sentences.en: What I discovered was that the king of mean, who shaped American TV culture and changed the music industry, is definitely in his cozy era.
sentences.zh: 我发现这位塑造了美国电视文化、改变了音乐产业的毒舌之王，绝对正处于他的舒适期。

sentences.en: Cal knows he's mellowed.
sentences.zh: 卡尔知道自己变得随和了。

sentences.en: Part of that is age.
sentences.zh: 部分原因在于年龄。

sentences.en: He's 66.
sentences.zh: 他66岁了。

sentences.en: But he's also suffered the loss of his parents, become a father, gone to therapy.
sentences.zh: 但他也经历过父母离世、成为父亲、去做心理治疗。

sentences.en: And more recently, he's grappled with the death of Liam Payne, whom he discovered on X Factor and cast in the mega-famous boy band One Direction, which we talked about at length.
sentences.zh: 更近一点，他一直在努力面对利亚姆·佩恩的去世，后者是他通过《X音素》发掘并选入超人气男孩乐队“单向乐队”的成员，我们对此进行了深入探讨。

sentences.en: Now, Cowell is looking for his next hit in his latest project, a Netflix docuseries called
sentences.zh: 现在，考威尔正在其最新项目中寻找下一个爆款，这是一部名为

sentences.en: Simon Cowell, The Next Act.
sentences.zh: 《西蒙·考威尔：下一幕》的Netflix纪录片系列。

sentences.en: In it, Cowell goes back to his roots as a talent scout, auditioning and training a group of teenagers to be in his new boy band.
sentences.zh: 在片中，考威尔回归了他作为星探的根基，试镜并训练了一群青少年加入他的新男孩乐队。

sentences.en: At a moment in our culture where bullying seems to be such a driving force, I was interested
sentences.zh: 在我们文化的这个时刻，霸凌似乎成了一股如此强大的推动力，我很感兴趣

sentences.en: in Cowell's evolution away from his harsh public persona, how he sees the music industry today, and his plans to stay relevant in it.
sentences.zh: 于考威尔如何摆脱他严厉的公众形象进行演变，他今天如何看待音乐产业，以及他在其中保持热度的计划。

sentences.en: Here's my conversation with Simon Cowell.
sentences.zh: 以下是我与西蒙·考威尔的对话。

sentences.en: All right, are we ready to go?
sentences.zh: 好了，我们准备好了吗？

sentences.en: We're good.
sentences.zh: 我们好了。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Simon Cowell, thank you so much for coming on the interview.
sentences.zh: 西蒙·考威尔，非常感谢你来参加《访谈》。

sentences.en: Thank you for coming over.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你过来。

sentences.en: I want to start by telling you that I was in L.A.
sentences.zh: 我想先告诉你，今年春天我在洛杉矶

sentences.en: this past spring for a family vacation, and we went to an America's Got Talent taping.
sentences.zh: 度过了一次家庭假期，我们去观看了《美国达人秀》的录制。

sentences.en: And I have two things to note about that experience.
sentences.zh: 关于那次经历，我有两点想指出。

sentences.en: First, the thing that occurred to me is the power of booing, the power of the boo.
sentences.zh: 首先，我脑海中浮现的是嘘声的力量，嘘声的威力。

sentences.en: You know, applauding and cheering are really, really fun.
sentences.zh: 你知道，鼓掌和欢呼真的非常非常有趣。

sentences.en: But what was also really great is to boo a judge.
sentences.zh: 但同样非常棒的是嘘评委。

sentences.en: And we booed you very, very energetically.
sentences.zh: 我们非常非常起劲地嘘了你。

sentences.en: You included.
sentences.zh: 包括你在内。

sentences.en: Yeah, me included, my daughter.
sentences.zh: 是的，包括我，还有我女儿。

sentences.en: We were very invested in booing you.
sentences.zh: 我们对嘘你这件事非常投入。

sentences.en: And I just wonder what it's like being on the other side of that.
sentences.zh: 我只是想知道身处那一面的感觉是什么样的。

sentences.en: It makes me laugh, to be honest with you.
sentences.zh: 说实话，这让我发笑。

sentences.en: I mean, it genuinely makes me laugh because it's like they can boo, you know, you like crazy.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这真的让我发笑，因为这就好像他们可以疯狂地嘘你，你知道的。

sentences.en: And then in the break, you just turn around and go, how are you doing?
sentences.zh: 然后在大休时，你转过身去说，你们过得怎么样？

sentences.en: And everyone's like friendly again.
sentences.zh: 每个人又都变得像朋友一样。

sentences.en: But in that moment, they're like really, like you said, invested.
sentences.zh: 但在那一刻，他们就像你说的，真的非常投入。

sentences.en: And I think that's the cool thing about having an audience behind you.
sentences.zh: 我认为这就是身后有观众的酷炫之处。

sentences.en: Because I always say to the producer, I can feel when something's going good or bad by the energy behind me.
sentences.zh: 因为我总是对制作人说，通过我身后的能量，我能感觉到事情进展得好还是坏。

sentences.en: But to your point, we actually try and encourage it, which is, if you're really unhappy with us, then tell us.
sentences.zh: 但正如你所说，我们实际上试图鼓励它，也就是说，如果你对我们很不满，那就告诉我们。

sentences.en: I mean, seriously, tell us.
sentences.zh: 我是说，说真的，告诉我们。

sentences.en: You know, I don't care.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我不在乎。

sentences.en: And the second thing you just touched on that occurred to me while I was watching you,
sentences.zh: 你刚刚提到的第二点，我在看着你的时候想到了，

sentences.en: you were the only judge turning around and actually engaging with the audience in between takes.
sentences.zh: 你是唯一一个在拍摄间隙转过身去真正与观众互动的评委。

sentences.en: And, you know, in reading about you, I read that your dad always told you when you were really young how important it is to make people feel important.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，在阅读关于你的资料时，我读到你爸爸在你很小的时候总是告诉你，让人觉得自己很重要是多么重要。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And I was wondering if you're still taking that advice to heart.
sentences.zh: 我想知道你是否仍然把这个建议铭记在心。

sentences.en: Yeah, very much so, yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的，非常铭记，是的。

sentences.en: I mean, you know, from the minute you walk, I walk into like the set, I think because of what my dad said years ago,
sentences.zh: 我是说，你知道，从你走进布景的那一分钟起，我想因为我爸爸多年前说过的话，

sentences.en: it really stuck in my mind that you have to be aware of genuine, literally every single person who's around you, you know, whether they're security, whoever they are.
sentences.zh: 它真的深深印在我的脑海里，你必须意识到真诚地对待你周围的每一个人，字面上的每一个人，无论他们是安保人员，还是任何人。

sentences.en: And obviously, without the audience there or watching, then you don't get paid.
sentences.zh: 显然，如果没有观众在那里或观看，你就拿不到报酬。

sentences.en: So you've got to be nice to them.
sentences.zh: 所以你必须对他们好。

sentences.en: And I say this to all my artists, you know, I work with, you know, which is if you ever lose sight of that, if you start complaining about privacy, photographs, autographs,
sentences.zh: 我对所有与我合作的艺术家都这样说，你知道，也就是如果你失去了对这一点的关注，如果你开始抱怨隐私、照片、签名，

sentences.en: then honestly, you're in the wrong job because the minute you put a song out or you go on TV or you make a movie, whatever, then of course your life is going to change.
sentences.zh: 那么老实说，你选错了工作，因为只要你发行一首歌、上电视或拍电影，无论什么，那么你的生活当然会改变。

sentences.en: You know, speaking of your dad, he was an executive at EMI, the big record label and music publishing company.
sentences.zh: 说到你父亲，他是EMI的高管，这是一家大型唱片公司和音乐出版公司。

sentences.en: And his job, though, was to manage real estate.
sentences.zh: 但他的工作是管理房地产。

sentences.en: He wasn't actually a creative, so to speak.
sentences.zh: 可以说，他其实并不是一个创意人员。

sentences.en: What did he think you'd become when you were young?
sentences.zh: 当你还小的时候，他以为你会成为什么样的人？

sentences.en: What did he hope for you?
sentences.zh: 他对你有什么期望？

sentences.en: It was so random what they thought I could do because I was so terrible at school.
sentences.zh: 他们对我的能力有各种各样的猜测，因为我在学校表现太糟糕了。

sentences.en: I just didn't like it.
sentences.zh: 我就是不喜欢。

sentences.en: I found it boring.
sentences.zh: 我觉得它很无聊。

sentences.en: I did everything I could to get out of it.
sentences.zh: 我想方设法逃避它。

sentences.en: I wanted to leave at 16 and I did.
sentences.zh: 我想在16岁时离开，我也确实做到了。

sentences.en: I think I left on my 16th birthday because I just, I thought, I'm just, nothing's digesting here.
sentences.zh: 我想我在16岁生日那天离开了，因为我只是觉得，我就是，这里什么也吸收不进去。

sentences.en: And they were concerned because I didn't pass any of my exaMs.
sentences.zh: 他们很担心，因为我没有通过任何考试。

sentences.en: So they just tried to get me a job.
sentences.zh: 所以他们只是想给我找份工作。

sentences.en: So my dad, because like you said, he was in property, he took me up to one of these places up in the north of England where they teach you to become a builder.
sentences.zh: 所以我的爸爸，就像你说的，他从事房地产工作，他把我带到英格兰北部那些教你如何成为建筑工人的地方之一。

sentences.en: And so we went on this kind of huge building site, you know, with diggers and everything.
sentences.zh: 于是我们去了这样一个巨大的建筑工地，你知道，有挖掘机什么的。

sentences.en: And I thought, well, this looks fun.
sentences.zh: 我想，嗯，这看起来挺有意思的。

sentences.en: And then I had the second part of the interview where they told me what I had to learn about maths and this and that.
sentences.zh: 然后我进行了面试的第二部分，他们告诉我必须学习数学这啊那啊的。

sentences.en: And I thought, OK, well, forget that.
sentences.zh: 我想，好吧，那就算了吧。

sentences.en: And then my mum thought I should work for the civil service for some reason.
sentences.zh: 然后我妈妈认为我出于某种原因应该去为公务员部门工作。

sentences.en: And I had this really terrible, terrible job interview, which was worse than being at school.
sentences.zh: 我进行了一次非常非常糟糕的工作面试，比在学校还要糟糕。

sentences.en: And then eventually a job came up as a runner at Elstree Studios, which was also a film, you know, it was a film studio, TV studios.
sentences.zh: 然后最终埃尔斯特里制片厂出现了一个跑腿的职位，那也是一个电影，你知道的，它是一个电影制片厂、电视制片厂。

sentences.en: And this was actually a TV show.
sentences.zh: 这其实是一个电视节目。

sentences.en: So I managed to get a job for three months as a runner.
sentences.zh: 所以我设法找到了一个为期三个月的跑腿工作。

sentences.en: And I actually just loved it from the minute I started.
sentences.zh: 从我开始的那一分钟起，我实际上就爱上了它。

sentences.en: I mean, you literally do run basically for everyone.
sentences.zh: 我是说，基本上所有人叫你跑腿你都要跑。

sentences.en: Whatever they ask you to do, you run.
sentences.zh: 无论他们要求你做什么，你都要跑。

sentences.en: And I loved it.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢它。

sentences.en: I absolutely loved it.
sentences.zh: 我绝对太喜欢了。

sentences.en: You eventually end up going into the music industry, doing A&R, which is basically being a talent scout.
sentences.zh: 你最终进入了音乐行业，做A&R，也就是基本上做一名星探。

sentences.en: What was it about the music industry that you found compelling at that point?
sentences.zh: 在那个阶段，音乐行业的什么吸引了你？

sentences.en: Why did you think that this was a place that you could actually kind of make your way?
sentences.zh: 为什么你认为这是一个你可以闯出一片天地的领域？

sentences.en: Well, I made a decision eventually just to get into TV musical film.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我最终决定进入电视音乐电影行业。

sentences.en: So I had the runner job.
sentences.zh: 所以我有了跑腿的工作。

sentences.en: I did actually try and get a job as a runner on The Shining, which they were making.
sentences.zh: 我实际上确实试图在正在制作的《闪灵》中谋得一份跑腿的工作。

sentences.en: And for some reason, Stanley Kubrick, don't ask me why, would never hire runners.
sentences.zh: 出于某种原因，斯坦利·库布里克，别问我为什么，从来不雇佣跑腿的。

sentences.en: It must be some weird superstition or something.
sentences.zh: 这一定是什么奇怪的迷信之类的东西。

sentences.en: So I thought, OK.
sentences.zh: 所以我想，好吧。

sentences.en: And then I applied to be in the post room at a TV company and got turned down.
sentences.zh: 然后我申请去一家电视公司的收发室，结果被拒绝了。

sentences.en: And I'm like, how can you turn someone down to be in the mailroom?
sentences.zh: 我想，怎么会有人拒绝别人去收发室呢？

sentences.en: I mean, at 17 or something, but they did.
sentences.zh: 我是说，在17岁左右的时候，但他们确实拒绝了。

sentences.en: And then fortunately, my mum, I think she just wrote to EMI and said, my son wants to be in the music business.
sentences.zh: 然后幸运的是，我想我妈妈只是写信给EMI说，我儿子想进入音乐界。

sentences.en: And again, you had to go for a proper job interview.
sentences.zh: 同样，你得去参加一场正经的工作面试。

sentences.en: You know, the guy was called Personnel in those days.
sentences.zh: 你知道，那时候那个人被称为人事负责人。

sentences.en: The guy had a star on his door.
sentences.zh: 那家伙的门上有一颗星。

sentences.en: I remember that.
sentences.zh: 我记得那个。

sentences.en: And it was really cool because it wasn't just, you know, you've got to deliver mail.
sentences.zh: 这真的很酷，因为不只是，你知道，你得送信。

sentences.en: It was like, you know, what are your ambitions?
sentences.zh: 而是像，你知道的，你的雄心壮志是什么？

sentences.en: Why do you want to be here?
sentences.zh: 你为什么想来这里？

sentences.en: Blah, blah, blah.
sentences.zh: 等等等等。

sentences.en: And I said, I really actually want to be in the music business.
sentences.zh: 我说，我其实真的很想进入音乐界。

sentences.en: I don't know what yet, but I just love music.
sentences.zh: 我还不知道具体做什么，但我就是热爱音乐。

sentences.en: So this is just, you know, I hope I get that opportunity and I really will work hard.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是，你知道，我希望我能得到那个机会，我一定会努力工作的。

sentences.en: And when I got the news, I got the job.
sentences.zh: 当我得到消息时，我得到了这份工作。

sentences.en: It was like, yeah, brilliant.
sentences.zh: 那种感觉就像是，太棒了。

sentences.en: And you were how old?
sentences.zh: 你当时多大？

sentences.en: I must have been then, about 18, 19, I guess.
sentences.zh: 我那时一定，大概18、19岁吧，我想。

sentences.en: You eventually work your way up.
sentences.zh: 你最终通过努力一步步晋升。

sentences.en: And one of the things that you become pretty astute at is developing what is a broad view of what is culturally relevant back then.
sentences.zh: 你变得非常精明的一点是，能够对当年什么具有文化相关性形成广泛的看法。

sentences.en: I mean, I read a quote that you boasted that you'd figure out what was going on, not by going to dingy shows in basements, but by reading The Sun, which is, of course,
sentences.zh: 我是说，我读到过一句你夸口的话，你发现正在发生的事情，不是通过去地下地下室看破旧的演出，而是通过阅读《太阳报》，当然，

sentences.en: the storied British tabloid.
sentences.zh: 那是那家大名鼎鼎的英国小报。

sentences.en: And your first success came with the singer Sinita in the mid-1980s.
sentences.zh: 你的第一次成功是在20世纪80年代中期与歌手西妮塔合作取得的。

sentences.en: And I want to ask you about something in particular, because you were promoting her music initially by going to gay clubs and trying to get it played there.
sentences.zh: 我想问你一件具体的事，因为你最初是通过去同性恋俱乐部并试图让她的音乐在那里播放来推广她的音乐的。

sentences.en: What did you understand about who are the real cultural tastemakers that perhaps other people weren't understanding?
sentences.zh: 关于谁才是真正的文化风向标，你理解了什么，而其他人可能没有理解？

sentences.en: That's a good question.
sentences.zh: 这是个好问题。

sentences.en: So when I worked with Sinita, I thought she's going to become a gay icon.
sentences.zh: 所以当我和西妮塔合作时，我想她将成为一个同性恋偶像。

sentences.en: I could see that.
sentences.zh: 我能看出来这一点。

sentences.en: So we've got to find her a record that is a crossover record that we can break from the gay clubs.
sentences.zh: 所以我们必须为她找一张跨界唱片，我们可以从同性恋俱乐部打开突破口。

sentences.en: Because, you know, a lot of clubs we would go to, you know, some would, they just didn't get it, right?
sentences.zh: 因为，你知道，我们去的很多俱乐部，有些，他们就是不懂，对吧？

sentences.en: So I kind of thought this is fun, you know?
sentences.zh: 所以我当时觉得这很有趣，你知道吗？

sentences.en: So I used to take white labels, acetates, basically a vinyl record, and go into the DJ booth and just watch the reaction as the record was played.
sentences.zh: 所以我过去常常带着白标签唱片、醋酸唱片，基本上就是一张黑胶唱片，走进DJ台，看着唱片播放时的反应。

sentences.en: And it was really interesting because that gave me more feedback than anything else as to whether this record, you know, we were on the right track or not.
sentences.zh: 这真的很有趣，因为这给了我比任何事情都多的反馈，关于这张唱片，你知道，我们是否走对了路。

sentences.en: And they loved this first record, although I just couldn't get it on radio.
sentences.zh: 他们非常喜欢这第一张唱片，尽管我就是无法把它送上电台。

sentences.en: And there was a record I heard, actually it was Sinita's mum, actually, who recorded a song called So Many Men, which nearly was a hit.
sentences.zh: 我听过一张唱片，实际上是西妮塔的妈妈，她录制了一首歌叫《那么多男人》，差点成了一首热门歌曲。

sentences.en: So many men, so little time.
sentences.zh: 那么多男人，那么少时间。

sentences.en: Yeah, so little time.
sentences.zh: 对，那么少时间。

sentences.en: It's a brilliant song.
sentences.zh: 这是一首绝妙的歌。

sentences.en: All these songs are coming around at the same time.
sentences.zh: 所有这些歌曲同时涌现出来。

sentences.en: And I remember thinking, this is going to be big.
sentences.zh: 我记得当时想，这会大火的。

sentences.en: And we've just got to just jump on this wave somehow and use the clubs to get this record into the top 40.
sentences.zh: 我们必须以某种方式乘上这股浪潮，利用俱乐部把这张唱片推入前40名。

sentences.en: Because if I could get the record in the top 40, then radio were forced to play it, you know, on the national countdown.
sentences.zh: 因为如果我能把唱片打入前40名，那么电台就会被迫在全国倒计时节目中播放它，你知道的。

sentences.en: So it eventually got in the top 40, and then it got played, and then more radio stations played, and then eventually it went on at number two or something.
sentences.zh: 所以这首歌最终打进了前四十，然后开始被播放，接着更多电台也开始播放，最后它差不多冲到了第二名的位置。

sentences.en: So there's two things about this story that are interesting.
sentences.zh: 所以这个故事里有两点很有趣。

sentences.en: The first is you like to do an end run around gatekeepers, clearly.
sentences.zh: 第一点是，很显然你喜欢绕过把关人直接行动。

sentences.en: And the second thing I think about this story is that, you know, you ended up becoming well-known for then signing acts that, you know, a lot of people saw as gimmicky.
sentences.zh: 而关于这个故事的第二点，我觉得是，你知道的，你后来签下的艺人，很多人都觉得它们像是一些噱头，你也因此而闻名。

sentences.en: You signed the Power Rangers, WrestleMania, you made music from that.
sentences.zh: 你签了《超凡战队》和《摔角狂热》，你把它们做成了音乐。

sentences.en: And you have what I think is this sort of bottom-up approach to the business, which is let's see what's popular and then elevate it.
sentences.zh: 而你对待商业有一种我称之为自下而上的方法，也就是看看什么受欢迎，然后去推波助澜。

sentences.en: Where do you think that came from, that understanding of, you know, let's take what's popular and not be precious about it and try and put it out into the world?
sentences.zh: 你觉得这种理解是从哪里来的？就是那种“好吧，我们要采用流行元素，不要对它敝帚自珍，然后试着把它推向世界”的想法？

sentences.en: Well, all I was thinking was I've just got to keep a job.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我当时唯一的想法就是我得保住工作。

sentences.en: Got to keep the lights on.
sentences.zh: 得维持生计。

sentences.en: I've got to keep the lights on, exactly, yeah.
sentences.zh: 我得维持生计，完全没错，是的。

sentences.en: I've got to get paid.
sentences.zh: 我得赚钱。

sentences.en: And I know what it feels like to be broke, because I was broke, and I didn't want to go back there again.
sentences.zh: 而且我知道没钱是什么滋味，因为我曾经身无分文，我不想再回到那种日子。

sentences.en: I mean, you lost your apartment at a certain point.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你在某个阶段失去了公寓。

sentences.en: You lost, I mean, everything.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你失去了一切。

sentences.en: Your car, you had to move in with your parents again.
sentences.zh: 你的车，你不得不重新搬回父母家住。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Thank God my parents were very understanding.
sentences.zh: 谢天谢地，我父母非常理解我。

sentences.en: And they were like, well, just use it.
sentences.zh: 他们就说，行吧，就当吸取教训。

sentences.en: This is a lesson, Simon.
sentences.zh: 这是一次教训，西蒙。

sentences.en: You know, credit cards, you've got to pay back.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，信用卡你是要还的。

sentences.en: Mortgages, you've got to pay back.
sentences.zh: 房贷你是要还的。

sentences.en: So, you know, everything was kind of borrowed.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，一切基本上都是借来的。

sentences.en: So, you know, I lost everything, went back, did a deal with a bank, got a loan, got a label deal.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，我失去了一切，回去了，跟银行达成协议，贷了款，拿到了唱片公司的合同。

sentences.en: And at that point, I just thought, right, I don't want to go back to there again.
sentences.zh: 就在那个时候，我心想，好吧，我再也不想回到那种地方去了。

sentences.en: So, I'm going to do whatever I can to sell records, knowing it's the music business.
sentences.zh: 所以，我会不惜一切代价去卖唱片，因为这就是音乐产业。

sentences.en: Because we did used to go to these A&R meetings, and a lot of the guys, the A&R people, would have a job because they thought they were cooler than everybody else.
sentences.zh: 因为我们以前经常去参加这些A&R会议，很多家伙，那些A&R人员，之所以能保住工作，是因为他们觉得自己比所有人都酷。

sentences.en: Actually, a lot of them were just idiots.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他们当中很多人只是白痴。

sentences.en: They thought they were cool.
sentences.zh: 他们觉得自己很酷。

sentences.en: They were just guessing.
sentences.zh: 他们其实只是在瞎蒙。

sentences.en: And if you dared to play something they didn't like, you were like, they used to, like, sneer at me, laugh at me.
sentences.zh: 如果你敢播放他们不喜欢的东西，他们就会，他们以前会那样冷笑我、嘲笑我。

sentences.en: I mean, I remember once, you know, playing, as you said, that Power Rangers record, because my boss at the time said, look, we need to look at our last quarter.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我记得有一次，你知道的，就像你说的，我播放了那张《超凡战队》的唱片，因为我当时的 boss 说，听着，我们需要看看上一季度的业绩。

sentences.en: Who's got any hits?
sentences.zh: 谁手里有热门单曲？

sentences.en: So, I held my hand up.
sentences.zh: 于是我举起了手。

sentences.en: And I said, well, I've just sat at the Power Rangers, sneer, sneer, sneer, sneer.
sentences.zh: 我说，好吧，我刚做了一个《超凡战队》的项目，冷笑，冷笑，冷笑，冷笑。

sentences.en: And I've signed these two puppets.
sentences.zh: 我还签下了这两个木偶。

sentences.en: And so, she actually went to this PowerPoint presentation, you know, this whiteboard, and wrote zero, i.e. zero revenue, without hearing them.
sentences.zh: 于是，她竟然走到那个PowerPoint演示文稿前，你知道的，那个白板前，在根本没听过的情况下，写下了零，也就是零收入。

sentences.en: So, I thought, well, I'll just get on with it myself.
sentences.zh: 所以我心想，好吧，我自己干就是了。

sentences.en: But you understood something about the business, which is IP from things that aren't necessarily in music.
sentences.zh: 但你对这个行业有某种理解，那就是非音乐类事物的IP。

sentences.en: It could translate.
sentences.zh: 它是可以转化为商业价值的。

sentences.en: It could be valuable.
sentences.zh: 它是有价值的。

sentences.en: It could be sellable.
sentences.zh: 它是卖得出去的。

sentences.en: People would like it.
sentences.zh: 人们会喜欢它。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Well, with these IPs, when I knew that they'd sold out Wembley Stadium, the wrestlers, in 30 seconds, that's 80,000 seats.
sentences.zh: 好吧，对于这些IP，当我得知温布利球场在30秒内被那些摔角手卖光时，那是8万个座位。

sentences.en: I just went, well, whoever loves wrestling, there's a lot of music, you know, on these shows.
sentences.zh: 我当时就觉得，不管是谁喜欢摔角，你知道的，这些节目里有很多音乐。

sentences.en: I think they're going to buy the record.
sentences.zh: 我觉得他们会买这张唱片。

sentences.en: But I actually liked those records myself.
sentences.zh: 但我其实自己也很喜欢那些唱片。

sentences.en: So, I just thought, they're catchy.
sentences.zh: 所以我只是觉得，它们很洗脑。

sentences.en: They're fun.
sentences.zh: 它们很有趣。

sentences.en: You don't take it too seriously.
sentences.zh: 你不用太较真。

sentences.en: But more importantly, that we were selling millions and millions of records.
sentences.zh: 但更重要的是，我们当时卖出了数以百万计的唱片。

sentences.en: Your first sort of huge hit happens with the Irish boy band Westlife.
sentences.zh: 你的第一首大热单曲是通过爱尔兰男子演唱组合西城男孩取得的。

sentences.en: And you see them for the first time.
sentences.zh: 而你第一次见到他们的时候。

sentences.en: You turn them down.
sentences.zh: 你拒绝了他们。

sentences.en: And you tell their sort of manager or the person who was heading the band that you didn't like them because some of the boys weren't very good looking.
sentences.zh: 而且你告诉他们的经纪人或者负责这个组合的人，说你不喜欢他们，因为有些男孩长得不够帅。

sentences.en: And they took the note.
sentences.zh: 而他们听取了这条意见。

sentences.en: They get rid of some of the boys.
sentences.zh: 他们换掉了一些男孩。

sentences.en: And then when you saw them again, you signed them.
sentences.zh: 然后当你再次见到他们时，你签下了他们。

sentences.en: And I'm just wondering, when you're looking at a band like that back then, and just in general, are looks more important than talent?
sentences.zh: 我只是在想，当你当年看着这样一个乐队时，以及总体而言，外表比才华更重要吗？

sentences.en: Well, the first time I saw the boys, it was a mess.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我第一次见到这帮男孩时，那简直是一团糟。

sentences.en: There was no chemistry.
sentences.zh: 完全没有化学反应。

sentences.en: They didn't look right together.
sentences.zh: 他们凑在一起看着就不对劲。

sentences.en: It didn't excite me.
sentences.zh: 这没能让我兴奋起来。

sentences.en: It was just that.
sentences.zh: 就是这样。

sentences.en: And then the second time they saw them, the manager had styled them better, had replaced them.
sentences.zh: 然后第二次见到他们时，经纪人把他们包装得更好了，也换了人。

sentences.en: Within 30 seconds, truthfully, I just turned around to him and I said, I don't need to hear any more.
sentences.zh: 老实说，在30秒内，我转过身对他说，我不需要再听了。

sentences.en: We'll just do the deal tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我们明天就签约吧。

sentences.en: And we did.
sentences.zh: 然后我们就签约了。

sentences.en: And they could really sing, a couple of them in particular.
sentences.zh: 而且他们真的很会唱歌，尤其是其中好几个。

sentences.en: So my job now is to find them hits.
sentences.zh: 所以我现在的工作就是为他们找到热门歌曲。

sentences.en: It was simple as that.
sentences.zh: 就这么简单。

sentences.en: And that's when the relationship I was developing with songwriters and producers actually was probably more important than anything else.
sentences.zh: 正是在那个时候，我与词曲作者和制作人建立的关系可能比其他任何事情都重要。

sentences.en: No matter how good the idea is, the song is probably the most important factor in all of this.
sentences.zh: 不管这个创意有多好，这首歌可能才是这一切中最关键的因素。

sentences.en: So when I heard, when we got Westlife together, I heard a rumor that there was a song that somebody else was going to record.
sentences.zh: 所以当我听说，当我们把西城男孩凑在一起时，我听到一个传言，说有一首歌本来是别人要录制的。

sentences.en: And someone told me this song is a killer song.
sentences.zh: 有人告诉我这首歌是一首杀手级金曲。

sentences.en: And so I called up the two writers and I said, hey, you've written this song.
sentences.zh: 于是我给那两个词曲作者打电话说，嘿，你们写了这首歌。

sentences.en: Will you come over?
sentences.zh: 你们能过来一下吗？

sentences.en: They play me the demo.
sentences.zh: 他们给我放了小样。

sentences.en: And it's a no-brainer, this song.
sentences.zh: 这首歌简直毫无悬念的好。

sentences.en: And I thought, this is going to catapult Westlife.
sentences.zh: 我心想，这绝对能让西城男孩一飞冲天。

sentences.en: And I said, I want the song.
sentences.zh: 我说，我要这首歌。

sentences.en: We promised it to someone else.
sentences.zh: 我们已经把它承诺给别人了。

sentences.en: And I actually locked the door.
sentences.zh: 然后我居然把门给锁上了。

sentences.en: You what?
sentences.zh: 你说什么？

sentences.en: I locked them in my office.
sentences.zh: 我把他们锁在我的办公室里了。

sentences.en: And I said, you're not leaving until we do a deal.
sentences.zh: 我说，不把合同签了，你们休想离开。

sentences.en: That's a tactic.
sentences.zh: 这真是一种策略。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And they looked at me like, you're mad.
sentences.zh: 他们看着我，觉得我疯了。

sentences.en: I'm not mad.
sentences.zh: 我才没疯。

sentences.en: You'll have a bigger hit with these boys than the other artists because these are better singers.
sentences.zh: 这些男孩唱得更好，你们用他们取得的成绩会比和其他艺人的合作更好。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: We've been talking about all your successes, but you've also had plenty of flops and a few missed opportunities during this particular period.
sentences.zh: 我们一直在谈论你所有的成功，但在这个特定时期，你也经历了不少惨败和错失良机的时刻。

sentences.en: The band Take That, obviously, was a big one.
sentences.zh: 接招乐队，显而易见，就是一个很大的遗憾。

sentences.en: And then Kylie Minogue also was one that sort of got away.
sentences.zh: 然后凯莉·米洛也是一个差不多从指缝溜走的例子。

sentences.en: Was that your biggest regret, do you think?
sentences.zh: 你觉得这是你最大的遗憾吗？

sentences.en: Well, I mean, my biggest regret in terms of missing out was probably the Spice Girls.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我的意思是，就错失良机而言，我最大的遗憾可能是辣妹组合。

sentences.en: They were mentioned in an A&R meeting.
sentences.zh: 她们在一次A&R会议上被提起过。

sentences.en: They were called Spice then.
sentences.zh: 她们当时叫Spice。

sentences.en: And somebody said, we're hearing about this band called Spice because they were literally turning up at all the labels.
sentences.zh: 有人说，我们听说过这个叫Spice的乐队，因为她们简直是在各大唱片公司挨家挨户地跑。

sentences.en: And there was a buzz about them.
sentences.zh: 而且关于她们有很多热议。

sentences.en: Two of the A&R guys held their hands up and said, we're on it.
sentences.zh: 其中两个A&R人员举手说，这事包在我身上。

sentences.en: I'm on it.
sentences.zh: 我来搞定。

sentences.en: So I'm thinking, OK, I'm too late.
sentences.zh: 所以我心想，好吧，我来晚了。

sentences.en: And then by chance, a few weeks later, I went to a meeting at the people who used to promote our records.
sentences.zh: 然后好巧不巧，几周后，我去了一家曾为我们的唱片做宣传的公司开会。

sentences.en: And the girls happened to be in a van.
sentences.zh: 而那些女孩刚好坐在一辆面包车里。

sentences.en: And they knew who I was.
sentences.zh: 她们知道我是谁。

sentences.en: I don't know why or how, but they just did.
sentences.zh: 我不知道为什么也不知道怎么回事，但她们就是知道。

sentences.en: Dragged me into the van and played me the demo of Wannabe.
sentences.zh: 把我拉进面包车，给我放了《Wannabe》的小样。

sentences.en: And I'm like, oh, my God, they're going to be huge.
sentences.zh: 我当时就想，哦，天哪，她们要火遍全球了。

sentences.en: And got in my car, got back to the office, called the manager.
sentences.zh: 然后我上车，赶回办公室，给经纪人打了电话。

sentences.en: And I said, if you haven't signed a deal, I'll double whatever you've been offered.
sentences.zh: 我说，如果你还没签约，别人开价多少我给双倍。

sentences.en: He said, we signed yesterday.
sentences.zh: 他说，我们昨天刚签了。

sentences.en: Now, I don't know whether that was true or not, but that was really, really hard.
sentences.zh: 现在，我不知道这是真是假，但这真的、真的很让人难受。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: When I saw that blow up, I'm like, God.
sentences.zh: 当我看到她们彻底爆红时，我在想，天哪。

sentences.en: But every time, you know, something like that happens, weirdly, it just makes you more determined, I think.
sentences.zh: 但每次发生类似的事情时，说来奇怪，反而会让你更有斗志，我觉得。

sentences.en: So let's fast forward a little bit to American Idol.
sentences.zh: 所以让我们快进一点，来到《美国偶像》。

sentences.en: Reading your autobiography, one of the things that sort of jumped out at me is that you really struggled with how the public was initially perceiving you.
sentences.zh: 读你的自传时，有一件事让我感触很深，那就是你一开始真的很纠结公众对你的看法。

sentences.en: You know, that bluntness that you brought to the show that you really pushed to sort of incorporate.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你带到节目中的那种直言不讳，也是你极力想要融入其中的特质。

sentences.en: Once it became the mega hit that it became, you started reading this feedback.
sentences.zh: 一旦它成为了轰动一时的超级大热节目，你便开始阅读这些反馈。

sentences.en: And it caused you to kind of doubt yourself and later be nicer on the show for a little bit, which I don't remember this period, by the way.
sentences.zh: 这导致你开始自我怀疑，后来在节目中稍微变友善了一些，顺便说一句，我都记不清这段时期了。

sentences.en: I don't think you were ever particularly nice on the show.
sentences.zh: 我觉得你在节目里从来没有特别友善过。

sentences.en: But you sort of clocked that it made the show seem inauthentic.
sentences.zh: 但你多少意识到，这让节目显得不够真实。

sentences.en: I wasn't trying to be a dick on purpose.
sentences.zh: 我可不是故意要装混蛋的。

sentences.en: All I wanted with these shows was to find successful artists to sign to the label.
sentences.zh: 我做这些节目唯一的目的，就是寻找成功的艺人签约到旗下唱片公司。

sentences.en: So when all these people were coming in and they couldn't sing, you know, like we used to do off camera,
sentences.zh: 所以当所有这些人涌进来却根本不会唱歌时，你知道的，就像我们以前在镜头外做的那样，

sentences.en: I would be like when I used to do auditions and someone would come in and they can't sing.
sentences.zh: 每当我做试镜、有人进来却唱得一塌糊涂时，我就会这样。

sentences.en: We would say after 10 seconds, you can't sing.
sentences.zh: 我们会在10秒钟后说，你不会唱歌。

sentences.en: Not you're going to be brilliant and everything else.
sentences.zh: 而不是说你会前途无量之类的好话。

sentences.en: So I was frustrated at the beginning because I thought if we don't find someone good at the end of these shows, they're not going to get recommissioned.
sentences.zh: 所以我一开始感到很沮丧，因为我想，如果这些节目到头来找不到优秀的人，它们就不会续播了。

sentences.en: Well, there are a lot of Simon Cowell insult compilations from American Idol online.
sentences.zh: 网上有很多《美国偶像》里西蒙·考威尔的毒舌合集。

sentences.en: You'll be happy to know.
sentences.zh: 你听了大概会很高兴。

sentences.en: You told singers they'd invented a new form of torture.
sentences.zh: 你对歌手们说他们发明了一种新的酷刑。

sentences.en: You made some fat jokes.
sentences.zh: 你还开了一些关于肥胖的玩笑。

sentences.en: Lulu, do we have to go through this?
sentences.zh: 露露，我们非得经历这些吗？

sentences.en: Yes, we have to go through it.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们必须经历这些。

sentences.en: And then the camera would sort of cut to people looking absolutely crushed.
sentences.zh: 然后镜头会切到那些看起来备受打击的人身上。

sentences.en: I mean, what is the line, do you think, between bluntness and humiliation?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你觉得直言不讳和羞辱之间的界限在哪里？

sentences.zh: 我必须跟你说实话。

sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我后来确实做出了改变。

sentences.en: I mean, I did realize I've probably gone too far and I don't need to be.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我确实意识到我可能做得太过了，没必要那样。

sentences.en: Look, I was honestly, I was just, I was frustrated.
sentences.zh: 听着，说实话，我当时只是，我只是感到沮丧。

sentences.en: I didn't particularly, I still don't like audition days because they're long and boring.
sentences.zh: 我并不特别，我到现在还是不喜欢试镜日，因为又长又无聊。

sentences.en: I would get fed up.
sentences.zh: 我会感到厌烦。

sentences.en: And of course, you know, out of a hundred nice comments, what are they going to use?
sentences.zh: 当然，你知道的，在一百条好评中，他们会用哪一条？

sentences.zh: 他们总是会用我心情不好的那一面。

sentences.zh: 我能说什么呢？

sentences.zh: 我很抱歉。

sentences.zh: 你到底在为什么道歉？

sentences.en: Well, just being a dick, you know.
sentences.zh: 嗯，就是以前有点混蛋，你知道的。

sentences.en: But it also made good TV and it made you into an integral part of what made that show work.
sentences.zh: 但这也造就了不错的电视节目，而且你成了这个节目成功不可或缺的一部分。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: That was then.
sentences.zh: 那是过去的事了。

sentences.en: I'm not proud of it.
sentences.zh: 我并不以此为傲。

sentences.en: Let's put it that way.
sentences.zh: 这么说吧。

sentences.en: I don't look at this.
sentences.zh: 我不看这些。

sentences.en: I never look at this stuff online or anything.
sentences.zh: 我从不在网上或什么地方看这些东西。

sentences.en: You know, I'm not someone who particularly wants to see myself on camera.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我不是那种特别想在镜头前看到自己的人。

sentences.en: So when I hear about these clips, I'm like, oh, God.
sentences.zh: 所以当我听到这些片段时，我就会想，哦，天哪。

sentences.en: But then again, the upside is, I suppose, with these clips is that it made the shows really popular worldwide.
sentences.zh: 但话又说回来，我想这些片段的好处在于，它让这些节目在全世界都非常受欢迎。

sentences.en: It also launched the career of Ryan SeacreSt.
sentences.zh: 这也开启了瑞安·西克雷斯特的职业生涯。

sentences.en: And I'll be honest, I am mystified by how he is so ubiquitous and so popular.
sentences.zh: 说实话，他怎么能做到如此无处不在、如此受欢迎，我感到非常困惑。

sentences.en: And I wanted you to be able to explain it.
sentences.zh: 我想让你来解释一下。

sentences.en: I can't really answer that one, if I'm being honest with you.
sentences.zh: 说实话，我真的回答不了这个问题。

sentences.zh: 他确实很努力。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: A lot of people work hard.
sentences.zh: 很多人都很努力。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: I don't know, actually.
sentences.zh: 其实我也不知道。
