sentences.zh: 他非常有、非常具进取心。

sentences.en: And look, I don't follow his career, if I'm being honest with you.
sentences.zh: 听着，说实话，我并不关注他的职业生涯。

sentences.en: So I don't know what he's done or doing.
sentences.zh: 所以我不知道他做过什么或正在做什么。

sentences.en: You know, we rarely talk now.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们现在很少交流。

sentences.en: I always knew with Ryan, he was like very steely about his career, wanting to be famous.
sentences.zh: 我一直都知道瑞安对自己的职业生涯非常有野心，渴望出名。

sentences.en: I mean, this massive, massive desire about being very famous.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这种渴望成名的欲望非常、非常强烈。

sentences.en: Eventually, of course, you leave Idol to launch X Factor in the US, which was your own project.
sentences.zh: 当然，最后你离开了《偶像》，去美国推出了你自己的项目《X音素》。

sentences.en: And you recruited Britney Spears to be a judge on the show.
sentences.zh: 你还招募了布兰妮·斯皮尔斯担任该节目的评委。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And you spoke multiple times with her to get her to agree to that.
sentences.zh: 你和她谈了好几次，才让她同意这一点。

sentences.en: You know, at the time, you know, she was under a conservatorship.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当时她正处于监管之下。

sentences.en: I was wondering what you understood about her mental state, about what was going on around her.
sentences.zh: 我想知道你对她的精神状态以及她周围发生的事情了解多少。

sentences.en: This is a fascinating story about her and me and the show, because somebody said, Britney would be interested in working with you.
sentences.zh: 这是一个关于她、我和这个节目的迷人故事，因为有人说，布兰妮会有兴趣跟你合作。

sentences.en: And I'm like, really?
sentences.zh: 我说，真的吗？

sentences.en: And I said, well, would she talk to me on a call?
sentences.zh: 我说，那她愿意和我通个电话吗？

sentences.en: Because I thought, it's never going to happen.
sentences.zh: 因为我想，这绝不可能发生。

sentences.en: Yes, Friday night, eight o'clock.
sentences.zh: 是的，周五晚上八点。

sentences.en: Fine, she's going to call you.
sentences.zh: 好吧，她会给你打电话的。

sentences.en: So I'm waiting.
sentences.zh: 于是我在等待。

sentences.en: On the dot, she calls.
sentences.zh: 准时地，她打来电话。

sentences.en: And we spoke for two hours.
sentences.zh: 我们聊了两个小时。

sentences.en: And she was so fun, engaged, passionate, interesting, you know, just really, really wants to do it.
sentences.zh: 她非常有趣、投入、充满激情、引人入胜，你知道的，就是真的、真的很想做这件事。

sentences.en: I think for the right reasons, which was I want to be a kind of a mentor.
sentences.zh: 我想出于正确的理由，那就是我想成为某种导师。

sentences.en: I'm like, brilliant.
sentences.zh: 我说，太棒了。

sentences.en: So then I went, I want a second call.
sentences.zh: 所以我接着说，我想要第二次通话。

sentences.en: Because maybe this was a fluke.
sentences.zh: 因为也许这只是侥幸。

sentences.en: So we have a second call, I think, two weeks later.
sentences.zh: 所以我想在两周后我们进行了第二次通话。

sentences.en: It's even better.
sentences.zh: 效果甚至更好。

sentences.en: I went, wow, whatever I've heard about her.
sentences.zh: 我说，哇，无论我以前听过关于她什么传闻。

sentences.en: She is so smart, so nice, so friendly.
sentences.zh: 她是如此聪明、如此友善、如此亲切。

sentences.en: I think we're going to get on really, really well.
sentences.zh: 我想我们一定会相处得非常好。

sentences.en: Cut to we do a press launch.
sentences.zh: 快进到我们举办新闻发布会。

sentences.en: And Britney's there.
sentences.zh: 布兰妮也在场。

sentences.en: And she doesn't look that happy.
sentences.zh: 她看起来没那么高兴。

sentences.en: And I said, what's the matter?
sentences.zh: 我问，怎么了？

sentences.en: She said, I didn't realize there was going to be so much press around.
sentences.zh: 她说，我没意识到会有这么多媒体在场。

sentences.en: And I went, well, it is a press launch.
sentences.zh: 我说，好吧，这毕竟是新闻发布会。

sentences.en: So I said, well, that's kind of a bit too late to say you don't really want to do the press now.
sentences.zh: 所以我说，现在说你真的不想做媒体采访，已经有点太晚了。

sentences.en: So all I remember was there was a big tent.
sentences.zh: 所以我只记得有一个大帐篷。

sentences.en: And we were in two golf buggies.
sentences.zh: 我们坐在两辆高尔夫球车里。

sentences.en: And I had to go right.
sentences.zh: 我得往右拐。

sentences.en: She was ahead of me.
sentences.zh: 她走在我前面。

sentences.en: So as I went right, she just went straight on.
sentences.zh: 所以当我向右拐时，她直接往前开去了。

sentences.en: Because she didn't want to do the press.
sentences.zh: 因为她不想应付媒体。

sentences.en: And then on the show, she really struggled with saying no.
sentences.zh: 然后在节目中，她真的很难对别人说不。

sentences.en: To people.
sentences.zh: 对任何人。

sentences.en: It just didn't like it.
sentences.zh: 她就是不喜欢这样。

sentences.en: So the first day, I sat with her.
sentences.zh: 所以第一天，我和她坐在一起。

sentences.en: And I said, look, there's two choices.
sentences.zh: 我说，听着，有两个选择。

sentences.en: If you really don't want to do this, I'll get you out of it.
sentences.zh: 如果你真的不想做这个，我帮你脱身。

sentences.en: I really will.
sentences.zh: 我真的会这么做。

sentences.en: Or you've got to understand, I can't put 200 people in the final.
sentences.zh: 或者你必须明白，我不可能把200人送进决赛。

sentences.en: It's just not going to happen.
sentences.zh: 这是绝对不可能的。

sentences.en: It comes down to two.
sentences.zh: 最终只剩下两个人。

sentences.en: Which means, obviously, we are going to say no to people.
sentences.zh: 这意味着，很显然，我们要对一些人说不。

sentences.en: Now, I'll say no more than you.
sentences.zh: 现在，我会比你说更多的不。

sentences.en: But that's what we signed up for.
sentences.zh: 但这就是我们签约时承担的责任。

sentences.en: And I got to know her when she came over to my house one time.
sentences.zh: 有一次她来我家，我开始真正了解她。

sentences.en: And we just talked and talked and talked and talked.
sentences.zh: 我们就不停地聊啊、聊啊、聊啊、聊。

sentences.en: Because I really wanted to get inside her head.
sentences.zh: 因为我真的很想走入她的内心。

sentences.en: Was she happy?
sentences.zh: 她快乐吗？

sentences.en: Was she unhappy?
sentences.zh: 她不快乐吗？

sentences.en: She wasn't happy.
sentences.zh: 她并不快乐。

sentences.en: That's what I took away.
sentences.zh: 这就是我的结论。

sentences.en: It was like two different people, Lulet.
sentences.zh: 感觉就像有两个不同的人，鲁莱特。

sentences.en: And it was a shame.
sentences.zh: 真是遗憾。

sentences.en: I mean, she wrote in her memoir that she absolutely hated doing the show.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，她在回忆录中写道，她极其讨厌做这个节目。

sentences.en: Did she?
sentences.zh: 是吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: That's a shame.
sentences.zh: 真遗憾。

sentences.en: I did say to the network, I don't know if she wants to do it.
sentences.zh: 我确实对电视网说过，我不知道她是否想做这个。

sentences.en: And if she doesn't, we've got to give her the option of being able to leave.
sentences.zh: 如果她不想，我们必须给她离开的选择。

sentences.en: No one was forcing her or pressurizing her.
sentences.zh: 没有人强迫她或向她施压。

sentences.en: And actually, she also mentioned to me how much she didn't like pop music.
sentences.zh: 事实上，她还跟我提过她有多不喜欢流行音乐。

sentences.en: She was much more into, I don't know, a different kind of music, I think.
sentences.zh: 我想她更喜欢，我不知道，某种不同风格的音乐。

sentences.en: I don't think she really loved pop music.
sentences.zh: 我觉得她并不是真的很喜欢流行音乐。

sentences.en: So I think she probably struggled a bit with the whole mentoring the artists.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为她在指导艺人这方面可能有点挣扎。

sentences.en: I mean, if I saw her, yeah, I would talk to her about that whole time.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，如果我见到她，是的，我会和她谈谈那段时光。

sentences.en: Because it was her choice, genuinely.
sentences.zh: 因为这确实是她自己的选择。

sentences.en: Your other huge success happens around this period.
sentences.zh: 你的另一个巨大成功发生在这段时期前后。

sentences.en: Let's talk about One Direction.
sentences.zh: 我们来谈谈单向乐队。

sentences.en: Because you put the band together from a group of kids who auditioned for The X Factor.
sentences.zh: 因为你是把一群参加《X音素》试镜的孩子组成了这个乐队。

sentences.en: And I just watched Liam Payne's audition when he was 16.
sentences.zh: 我刚看了利亚姆·佩恩16岁时的试镜视频。

sentences.en: And you give him the standing ovation and he's got this beautiful smile and he's so excited about everything.
sentences.zh: 你为他起立鼓掌，他带着美丽的微笑，对一切都兴奋不已。

sentences.en: What do you remember about, you know, them at the very beginning?
sentences.zh: 关于他们刚开始的时候，你还记得些什么？

sentences.en: Well, Liam had auditioned for me when he was about 14, 15.
sentences.zh: 嗯，利亚姆大约14、15岁时曾为我试镜。

sentences.en: He was very young the first time and he got quite, you know, close to making the finals.
sentences.zh: 第一次时他年纪还很小，而且你知道的，离晋级决赛非常近。

sentences.en: And I remember having to say to him, it's just not your time.
sentences.zh: 我记得当时不得不对他说，现在还不是时候。

sentences.en: However, there's something about you I really like.
sentences.zh: 不过，你身上有一种特质我很喜欢。

sentences.en: Will you come back again?
sentences.zh: 你愿意再来吗？

sentences.en: And he came back two years later.
sentences.zh: 两年后他又回来了。

sentences.en: So that second time he came back and he nailed it on his audition.
sentences.zh: 所以在第二次回来时，他的试镜表现惊艳全场。

sentences.en: He's saying, cry me a river.
sentences.zh: 他唱的是《Cry Me a River》。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It was just that feeling of, you know, we were talking about the audience.
sentences.zh: 那种感觉就是，你知道的，我们在谈论观众。

sentences.en: You could feel it everywhere.
sentences.zh: 你到处都能感受到这一点。

sentences.en: And this look on his face, he was like, this is brilliant.
sentences.zh: 他脸上那种表情，就像是在说，这太棒了。

sentences.en: And then with the show, because there's so many people you take through to the next round.
sentences.zh: 然后在节目中，因为你要带进下一轮的人太多了。

sentences.en: And for whatever reason, he and a bunch of others just didn't do so well in the second part of the competition.
sentences.zh: 不管出于什么原因，他和另外好几个人在比赛的第二阶段表现得不是很好。

sentences.en: And I remember having to say no to a bunch of them, including Liam.
sentences.zh: 我记得不得不对他们中的很多人说不，包括利亚姆。

sentences.en: And I thought, Christ, I'm having to say no to him for the second time.
sentences.zh: 当时我想，天哪，我第二次不得不对他说不。

sentences.en: And then we went, actually, what if we put him with him, with him, with him, with him?
sentences.zh: 然后我们想，其实，如果我们把他和这个人、这个人、这个人、还有这个人组合在一起会怎样？

sentences.en: It took about 20 minutes, honestly, to make the decision.
sentences.zh: 老实说，做出这个决定只花了大约20分钟。

sentences.en: I actually remember seeing them walk towards me and I thought, God, they look really good together.
sentences.zh: 我确实记得看到他们朝我走来，当时我想，天哪，他们在一起看起来太棒了。

sentences.en: Something's gelled here.
sentences.zh: 这里产生了化学反应。

sentences.en: And I remember thinking, I had my poker face.
sentences.zh: 我记得当时我想，我得保持扑克脸。

sentences.en: I'm like, please, God, please, God, sing.
sentences.zh: 我在心里祈祷，求求上帝，求求上帝，让他们唱吧。

sentences.en: Please, God, sing.
sentences.zh: 求求上帝，让他们唱吧。

sentences.en: And they were great.
sentences.zh: 他们表现得很棒。

sentences.en: So in your new show, you're looking for a new boy band to launch.
sentences.zh: 所以在你的新节目中，你正在寻找一个新的男子乐队来推出。

sentences.en: And in the midst of filming, you received the news of Liam's death in Argentina in 2024.
sentences.zh: 在拍摄期间，你收到了利亚姆2024年在阿根廷去世的消息。

sentences.en: Can you tell me how you heard and then what you did to sort of process the loss?
sentences.zh: 你能告诉我你是怎么听到这个消息的，以及你后来做了什么来平复这种失落吗？

sentences.en: I, one of my...
sentences.zh: 我，我的其中一个……

sentences.en: And I know this is painful, so thank you.
sentences.zh: 我知道这很痛苦，所以谢谢你。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, of course, we're going to talk about it.
sentences.zh: 对，我的意思是，当然，我们要谈谈这个。

sentences.en: Somebody who works with me very close came into my room.
sentences.zh: 一个和我合作非常紧密的人走进了我的房间。

sentences.en: I was up in the north of England.
sentences.zh: 当时我在英格兰北部。

sentences.en: And I could tell on the look of her face that she was upset.
sentences.zh: 从她的表情上我能看出她很难过。

sentences.en: And, you know, she said that, you know, sit down.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，她让我坐下。

sentences.en: And she told me, and it was like, well, it's a bit like I felt when I heard the news about when my dad passed away.
sentences.zh: 然后她告诉我，那种感觉有点像我听到我父亲去世时的消息一样。

sentences.en: You know, that you can't really...
sentences.zh: 你知道，你真的无法……

sentences.en: It's very difficult to put into words how you feel other than it's just a shock, total shock and a surprise.
sentences.zh: 除了震惊、完全的震惊和意外之外，很难用言语来表达你的感受。

sentences.en: Even though my dad was in his 80s, I was still really surprised.
sentences.zh: 尽管我父亲已经八十多岁了，我还是感到非常震惊。

sentences.en: And obviously with Liam, even more surprised because he was so young.
sentences.zh: 显然对于利亚姆，因为他那么年轻，就更加震惊了。

sentences.en: And at that point, you're kind of, you're not really thinking clearly other than I just remember saying, I really need to speak to his mum and dad.
sentences.zh: 而在那个时候，你其实无法清晰地思考，脑子里唯一的想法就是我必须跟他的父母谈谈。

sentences.en: Can you get them on the phone as soon as possible, please?
sentences.zh: 请问你能尽快给他们去个电话吗？

sentences.en: Because I know, God, I mean, you know, as a parent, you know, what that must have, you know, felt like.
sentences.zh: 因为我懂，天哪，我的意思是，作为一个父母，你懂的，那种感觉会是怎样的。

sentences.en: And I was, I knew his mum and dad.
sentences.zh: 而且我当时，我认识他的爸爸妈妈。

sentences.en: And I wanted to reach out in that moment, you know, just to say, you know, how I felt.
sentences.zh: 我当时就想去联系他们，你知道的，只是想表达一下，你知道的，我的感受。

sentences.en: And it was just awful, awful.
sentences.zh: 那种感觉简直糟透了，太糟糕了。

sentences.en: And, you know, I'd seen him like a year before in this room, you know, and I remember seeing him walk into this room.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，大概一年前我还在这个房间里见过他，你知道的，我记得他走进来时的样子。

sentences.en: And I looked at him and, God, you look amazing, Liam, you know, you look great.
sentences.zh: 我看着他，天哪，你看起来太棒了，利亚姆，你知道的，你看上去棒极了。

sentences.en: What have you done?
sentences.zh: 你做了什么？

sentences.en: Well, I'm going to the gym and blah, blah, blah.
sentences.zh: 哦，我在健身啊，还有诸如此类的。

sentences.en: We talked about his son and, you know, how much it means to be a dad.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论了他的儿子，你知道的，当父亲意味着多么重大的意义。

sentences.en: And I was talking to him about, you know, there's more to life than just music.
sentences.zh: 我当时还跟他聊到，你知道的，生活中除了音乐还有更多的事情。

sentences.en: You know, you've got to a point in your life where you've got choice now, you know, etc.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，当你到了人生的某个阶段，你现在有了选择的权利，诸如此类。

sentences.en: And I think we were just hung out as friends.
sentences.zh: 我想我们当时就像朋友一样聚在一起。

sentences.en: That's why I was so shocked and surprised when I heard the news, you know.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么当我听到这个消息时，会感到如此震惊和意外，你知道的。

sentences.en: You know, since that happened, there's been a lot of reporting on One Direction, what happened while they were a band, the sort of drugs, the alcohol.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，自从那件事发生以来，有很多关于单向乐队的报道，关于他们在乐队期间发生了什么，比如毒品、酒精。

sentences.en: Well,
sentences.zh: 嗯，

sentences.en: Liam said on Diary of a CEO in 2021 that, and I'm quoting here, when we were in the band, the best way to secure us because of how big I got was just to lock us in our rooms.
sentences.zh: 利亚姆在2021年接受《CEO日记》采访时说过，我在这里引用原话：在我们组乐队的时候，因为我变得太红了，为了确保我们的安全，最好的办法就是把我们锁在房间里。

sentences.en: And, of course, what was in the room, the minibar.
sentences.zh: 然后，当然了，房间里有什么呢，迷你酒吧。

sentences.en: And so he, you know, talked about sort of struggling.
sentences.zh: 所以他，你知道的，谈到了那种挣扎。

sentences.en: Did you know about that at the time?
sentences.zh: 你当时知道这事吗？

sentences.en: A little bit.
sentences.zh: 知道一点。

sentences.en: And we, you know, there was stuff I never would have spoken about, you know, then, you know, which was private conversations I had and advice I tried to give him,
sentences.zh: 我们，你知道的，有些事我当时绝不会说出口，你知道的，那是我和他的私下谈话，以及我试图给他的建议，

sentences.en: which is what comes with fame, you know, etc., etc.
sentences.zh: 而这也是成名所带来的代价，你知道的，等等等等。

sentences.en: When you're signing a lot of artists, and when you sign an artist, you know, my role is essentially get them with the right production team, get the managers,
sentences.zh: 当你签约了很多艺人，当你签下一个艺人时，你知道的，我的职责基本上就是为他们安排合适的制作团队、经纪人，

sentences.en: and try and make them successful.
sentences.zh: 并尽力让他们获得成功。

sentences.en: But at the same time, I probably had about 20 artists on my books at the time.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，我当时手下大概有20个艺人。

sentences.en: And it is a little bit like they leave the nest, you know, you always say you're available as and when you need to be, but you can't follow them everywhere.
sentences.zh: 这有点像他们离巢独立，你知道的，你总是说随时准备提供帮助，但你不可能事事都跟着他们。

sentences.en: And if I could go back in time to that one day when he was in my house here, and then obviously, you know, you always think about things like that.
sentences.zh: 如果我能回到过去，回到他来到我家里做客的那天，然后显然，你知道的，你总是会想起这些事。

sentences.en: What if I'd said this, what if I'd said that, but, you know, there's only so much you can do with any artiSt.
sentences.zh: 如果我当时说了这个，如果我当时说了那个，但是，你知道的，对任何一个艺人来说，你所能做的都是有限的。

sentences.en: If you just have one artist in your life, maybe you can, you know, but I'm not a manager, which means my job is to run the label.
sentences.zh: 如果你生命中只有这一个艺人，也许你可以，你知道的，但我不是经纪人，这意味着我的工作是运营唱片公司。

sentences.en: And you just hope that they are, first of all, successful and happy.
sentences.zh: 你只能希望他们首先能获得成功并且开心。

sentences.en: But when you sign them, they were kids.
sentences.zh: 但当你签下他们时，他们还是孩子。

sentences.en: And so it must be that there is a different type of relationship that they have with someone like you who was also a judge and, you know, kind of brought them together.
sentences.zh: 所以，他们和你这样既当过评委、又可以说是把他们聚在一起的人之间，一定存在着一种不同类型的关系。

sentences.en: Is it a complicated role, that kind of relationship that you have with someone who is so young?
sentences.zh: 这是一个复杂的角色吗？你和这么年轻的人之间保持的那种关系？

sentences.en: It's always complicated, to be honest with you.
sentences.zh: 说实话，这总是很复杂的。

sentences.en: I don't know whether it's more complicated when they're young or someone who's had success then hasn't had success and comes back and wants a second chance.
sentences.zh: 我不知道当他们还年轻时更复杂，还是当某人曾经成功过、后来不红了又卷土重来想要第二次机会时更复杂。

sentences.en: I mean, every time it's different, Lulu.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，每一次情况都不同，露露。

sentences.en: You know, every artist is different.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，每个艺人都不同。

sentences.en: There's not a pattern you can say.
sentences.zh: 没有什么一成不变的模式。

sentences.en: You know, you have to work differently with each artiSt.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你必须针对每个艺人采取不同的合作方式。

sentences.en: Everybody has the same ambition, which is they come on our shows or they want to work with me.
sentences.zh: 所有人的雄心都是一样的，那就是他们来到我们的节目，或者他们想和我合作。

sentences.en: Because their dream is to be successful.
sentences.zh: 因为他们的梦想就是获得成功。

sentences.en: We made these shows because I understood and still do that there's always someone out there waiting to be discovered if you actually look.
sentences.zh: 我们制作这些节目是因为我明白，而且现在也明白，只要你肯去寻找，总会有人在等待被发掘。

sentences.en: The chances of getting well-known are just minute.
sentences.zh: 成名的机率其实微乎其微。

sentences.en: And then, like I'm doing now, same thing, young kids.
sentences.zh: 然后就像我现在做的一样，情况完全一样，都是年轻人。

sentences.en: And you ask yourself, is it a good thing or not?
sentences.zh: 你会问自己，这是一件好事还是坏事？

sentences.en: Without this show, what I'm doing, would they be discovered?
sentences.zh: 如果没有这个节目，没有我正在做的事，他们会被发掘吗？

sentences.en: I don't think so.
sentences.zh: 我不觉得会。

sentences.en: Is it something they want to do?
sentences.zh: 这是他们想做的事吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So, at the end of the day, you want people to be successful and happy.
sentences.zh: 所以，归根结底，你希望人们能够成功且快乐。

sentences.en: That's kind of what you set out to do.
sentences.zh: 这基本上就是你出发时的初衷。

sentences.en: What happened to Liam?
sentences.zh: 利亚姆发生了什么？

sentences.en: You know, for many people, it was a sign of how toxic fame can be.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，对许多人来说，这标志着名气能有多么大的毒害性。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And how hard it is to know at the beginning of your career how it's going to affect you.
sentences.zh: 而且在职业生涯之初，要弄清楚它会如何影响你，是多么艰难的一件事。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: What is the lesson you take from it?
sentences.zh: 你从中吸取了什么教训？

sentences.en: It's very difficult because I don't honestly know what is harder, which is trying to be famous or managing your fame.
sentences.zh: 这很难说，因为老实说我也不知道哪个更难，是努力成名还是管理你的名气。

sentences.en: Both are equally difficult.
sentences.zh: 这两者同样艰难。

sentences.en: But there's obviously something.
sentences.zh: 但显然有些事情是存在的。

sentences.en: You know, myself, I can say this about myself.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，就我个人而言，关于我自己我可以说：

sentences.en: I made my own choices.
sentences.zh: 我做出了自己的选择。

sentences.en: Not every day has been amazing.
sentences.zh: 并非每一天都那么美好。

sentences.en: But I still would.
sentences.zh: 但我还是会这样做。

sentences.en: I'm glad I did what I did.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴我做了我做过的事。

sentences.en: You know, I just made a decision to do something different in my life.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我只是决定在生活中做一些不同的事情。

sentences.en: And it was, you know, it comes obviously with pressure, a lot of pressure, a lot of stress.
sentences.zh: 而且它，你知道的，显然伴随着压力，巨大的压力，极大的焦虑。

sentences.en: But I signed up for it because obviously there was something inside of me saying I want to be well known, I guess.
sentences.zh: 但我接受了这一切，因为我内心深处显然有什么声音在告诉我，我想成名，我想是的。

sentences.en: And I would do it all over again.
sentences.zh: 而且我愿意重来一次。

sentences.en: So, your new show, as we mentioned, the premise is that you're creating a new boy band.
sentences.zh: 所以，正如我们所提到的，你的新节目核心理念是你要打造一个新的男子乐队。

sentences.en: I've seen you talk about how few new worldwide bands have been launched lately in the UK, in the United States.
sentences.zh: 我看到你谈到最近在英国和美国，很少有新的全球性乐队出道。

sentences.en: And once I saw that, I was like, it is actually true.
sentences.zh: 一旦我注意到这一点，我就觉得：这确实是真的。

sentences.en: What do you think is going on?
sentences.zh: 你觉得是怎么回事？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I genuinely don't know.
sentences.zh: 我真的不知道。

sentences.en: I knew that K-pop was going to be big.
sentences.zh: 我以前就知道K-pop会大火。

sentences.en: I could sort of feel it.
sentences.zh: 我当时隐约能感觉到。

sentences.en: And, I mean, credit to them.
sentences.zh: 而且，说实话，真该归功于他们。

sentences.en: I mean, they've done an amazing job.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们做得太棒了。

sentences.en: I mean, they're like part of South Korea's like economy.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们就像是韩国经济的一部分。

sentences.en: They're so huge.
sentences.zh: 他们太庞大了。

sentences.en: So, someone has gone, there's a market for bands, and they have absolutely nailed it.
sentences.zh: 所以，有人看准了乐队的市场，而且他们完美地做到了。

sentences.en: However, from the UK and America, there hasn't been, whether male or female, a breakout band.
sentences.zh: 然而，在英国和美国，无论是男团还是女团，都没有出现爆发式的乐队。

sentences.en: And, in fact, one of my, obviously, One Direction, or Fifth Harmony, you know, boys and girls, were probably the last two that really had a big impact worldwide.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我的，显然还有单向乐队，或者第五和谐，你知道的，这些男孩和女孩组合，可能是最后两支真正对全球产生巨大影响的乐队。

sentences.en: Something that also occurred to me is that we're now seeing the sort of emergence of AI-generated music and even AI musicians.
sentences.zh: 我还注意到的一点是，我们现在看到了AI生成音乐甚至AI音乐人的崛起。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: What do you think about that?
sentences.zh: 你怎么看？

sentences.en: I mean, would you ever sign an AI artist?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你会签下一个AI艺人吗？

sentences.en: Well, I mean, I guess so.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我的意思是，我猜会吧。

sentences.en: I mean, if I thought it would be successful, they, him, her, I don't know what you would say.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，如果我认为他会成功，他们、他、她，我不知道该怎么称呼。

sentences.en: It, yes.
sentences.zh: 它，是的。

sentences.en: It would be successful.
sentences.zh: 它会成功的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Um, I'm not thrilled at the prospect, if I'm being honest with you.
sentences.zh: 嗯，说实话，我对这个前景并不是很兴奋。

sentences.en: It's not really my thing.
sentences.zh: 这其实不是我的菜。

sentences.en: I mean, that's why I said to the people we were making the documentary with, I said, I can't explain to you how exciting it is when you've got a band.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这就是为什么我对制作这部纪录片的人说，我说，当你们拥有一个乐队时，那种兴奋感是无法用语言形容的。

sentences.en: It's so compelling and so exciting when you think it's starting to work.
sentences.zh: 当你觉得它开始奏效时，那种吸引力和兴奋感是无与伦比的。

sentences.en: And, importantly, when they start to believe it's going to work.
sentences.zh: 更重要的是，当他们开始相信它会成功的时候。

sentences.en: You know, we all know that it is, uh, harder to have your finger on the pulse as you get older.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们都知道随着年龄的增长，要紧跟时代潮流会变得更加困难。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I say this myself.
sentences.zh: 我自己也这么说。

sentences.en: Um, are you worried about that?
sentences.zh: 嗯，你对此感到担心吗？

sentences.en: Because, you know, you do note in the show that you're in your 60s trying to figure out what teenagers today want.
sentences.zh: 因为，你知道的，你在节目中也提到自己已经六十多岁了，却还在琢磨现在的青少年想要什么。

sentences.en: And I have a teenager, as, as do you, a little younger than a teenager.
sentences.zh: 而我有一个青少年孩子，正如你一样，虽然比青少年还要小一点。

sentences.en: And it seems like a different generation completely in the way that they consume things and discover things.
sentences.zh: 他们消费事物和发现事物的方式，看起来完全是另外一个时代的人。

sentences.en: Well, yes, I guess, let me work this out.
sentences.zh: 嗯，是的，我想，让我想想。

sentences.en: I was in my 50s when, you know, I had One Direction, Fifth Harmony, whatever, Little Mix.
sentences.zh: 当我拥有单向乐队、第五和谐或者Mix组合时，我其实已经五十多岁了。

sentences.en: I had a lot of bands who were selling.
sentences.zh: 我当时有很多非常畅销的乐队。

sentences.en: I don't know whether age, uh, was a factor or not.
sentences.zh: 我不知道年龄是不是一个因素。

sentences.en: I think the biggest thing really was the amount of time since my last band to this time.
sentences.zh: 我认为最大的因素其实是从我的上一个乐队到这一次之间的时间跨度。

sentences.en: And in between that time, K-pop's arrived, social media, like you said, TikTok is everywhere.
sentences.zh: 在这期间，K-pop崛起了，社交媒体出现了，就像你说的，TikTok随处可见。

sentences.en: And we, that wasn't really a huge factor then.
sentences.zh: 而在当时，这并不是一个巨大的影响因素。

sentences.en: So, so the change in 10 years is ginormous.
sentences.zh: 所以，这十年间的变化是巨大的。

sentences.en: And you just have to, there's, there's just no guarantee other than I think who we've selected are really good.
sentences.zh: 你只能，除了我们挑选的人真的很优秀之外，没有任何事情是有保证的。

sentences.en: But I never know until you put the group out there whether they're going to be successful or not.
sentences.zh: 但在你把这个组合推向大众之前，你永远不知道他们会不会成功。

sentences.en: You just don't know.
sentences.zh: 你根本无从得知。

sentences.en: And that's part of the buzz, I suppose.
sentences.zh: 我想，这也是那种刺激感的一部分吧。

sentences.en: Not knowing, because I don't.
sentences.zh: 因为我不知道，所以才未知。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: This is perhaps a strange place to end, but you recently had a very big pop culture moment when you were on the Jennifer Hudson show.
sentences.zh: 这或许是一个奇怪的结尾，但你最近在詹妮弗·哈德逊的节目上引发了极大的流行文化轰动。

sentences.en: I heard about this.
sentences.zh: 我听说过这事。

sentences.en: You did the spirit tunnel where you walk down the hall while her staff does a little song and dance.
sentences.zh: 你走过了那个“灵魂通道”，在走廊里走着，而她的工作人员在一旁载歌载舞。

sentences.en: And it was everywhere, Simon.
sentences.zh: 而且到处都是这个视频，西蒙。

sentences.en: And the comments seemed, one, they were confused about the way you were clapping.
sentences.zh: 评论似乎都在说，第一，他们对你鼓掌的方式感到困惑。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And too surprised that you actually have legs because a lot of people have only seen you behind a judge's podium on television.
sentences.zh: 第二，惊讶于你竟然真的长了腿，因为很多人在电视上只见过你坐在评委席后面。

sentences.en: You're so right.
sentences.zh: 你说的太对了。

sentences.en: But that is so funny you should ask that question because it did occur to me.
sentences.zh: 但你能问这个问题真的太有趣了，因为我也确实想过这个问题。

sentences.en: Let's say I had got hit by a bus six months ago.
sentences.zh: 假设我在六个月前被公共汽车撞了。

sentences.en: What would people know me for?
sentences.zh: 人们会因为什么记住我？

sentences.en: Well, my job was sitting behind a desk with three or four other people pressing buttons.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我的工作就是坐在桌子后面，和三四个人一起按按钮。

sentences.en: That's it.
sentences.zh: 就这些。

sentences.en: And I thought, it's going to be more than that.
sentences.zh: 我想，情况应该不止于此。

sentences.en: I mean, at least I can show that I still have that kind of work ethic and I really do love what I do.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，至少我可以证明我仍然保持着那种职业道德，而且我是真心热爱我的工作。

sentences.en: And I'm not afraid to show it.
sentences.zh: 我也不怕表现出来。

sentences.en: And I walk.
sentences.zh: 而且我还会走路。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: But what were you doing with your hands?
sentences.zh: 但你当时用手在干嘛呢？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I hadn't seen it back.
sentences.zh: 我还没回看那个视频。

sentences.en: Oh.
sentences.zh: 哦。

sentences.en: Tell me.
sentences.zh: 跟我说说。

sentences.en: There was some weird...
sentences.zh: 当时有些怪异……

sentences.en: It was quite embarrassing.
sentences.zh: 挺尴尬的。

sentences.en: I didn't know it was going to happen.
sentences.zh: 我根本不知道会发生这种事。

sentences.en: I mean, I'm married to an Englishman, so I understand sometimes dancing is a challenge.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我嫁给了一个英国人，所以我明白有时候跳舞是个挑战。

sentences.en: I could never watch it.
sentences.zh: 我永远没法看这个视频。

sentences.en: I'd be mortified.
sentences.zh: 我会羞愧得无地自容的。

sentences.en: But it made me laugh.
sentences.zh: 不过这逗笑了我。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: We're going to end here for now.
sentences.zh: 我们今天就先聊到这里。

sentences.en: We're going to talk again.
sentences.zh: 我们还会再聊的。

sentences.en: And we're going to talk a little bit about your personal life and your family.
sentences.zh: 而且我们接下来要聊聊你的个人生活和家庭。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: We do get a glimpse in this new documentary about, you know, your home life and how much it's changed.
sentences.zh: 在这部新纪录片里，我们确实能一窥你的家庭生活，以及它发生了多大的变化。

sentences.en: And so we're going to talk a little bit about that.
sentences.zh: 所以我们要稍微聊聊这个话题。

sentences.en: Thank you, Lulu.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，露露。

sentences.en: Thank you, Simon.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，西蒙。

sentences.en: That brought back a lot of memories.
sentences.zh: 这勾起了我很多回忆。

sentences.en: After the break, I talk to Simon again, and he tells me how having a son brought him out of depression.
sentences.zh: 休息过后，我将再次与西蒙对话，他会告诉我拥有一个儿子是如何把他从抑郁中拉出来的。

sentences.en: He came in one day, and it was about 2.30 in the afternoon, and he went, Dad, what are you doing asleep?
sentences.zh: 有一天他走了进来，大约是下午两点半，他说，爸爸，你还在睡觉干嘛呢？

sentences.en: And I went, God, he's right.
sentences.zh: 然后我想，天哪，他说得对。

sentences.en: I've got to readjuSt.
sentences.zh: 我得调整一下了。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是威娜露。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games, and I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》游戏板块字谜游戏 Connections 的创作者，我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog, and I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗，也喜欢试着捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基，我每天创作 Spelling Bee 和 Letterboxd 这两款游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做联觉的现象。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我在听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由真人制作的，就像你刚才听到的那些创作者一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com 栏目 slash games，今天就开始玩吧。

sentences.en: Okay, lovely.
sentences.zh: 好的，太棒了。

sentences.en: Are we good?
sentences.zh: 我们这样可以吗？

sentences.en: Can you hear me?
sentences.zh: 你能听到我说话吗？

sentences.en: I can hear you.
sentences.zh: 我能听到你。

sentences.en: Can you hear me?
sentences.zh: 你能听到我吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 听得到。

sentences.en: Where are you, Lulu?
sentences.zh: 露露，你在哪里？

sentences.en: I'm in London, and you are in the Cotswolds at your house.
sentences.zh: 我在伦敦，而你在科茨沃尔德的家里。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: I'm very happy here, Lulu.
sentences.zh: 我在这是非开心，露露。

sentences.en: Even though it's pissing with rain.
sentences.zh: 尽管外面下着倾盆大雨。

sentences.en: It's English weather.
sentences.zh: 这就是英国的天气。

sentences.en: So, you know, there's been a lot of discussion in the music industry about artists owning their work.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，音乐界最近有很多关于艺术家拥有自己作品所有权的讨论。

sentences.en: You know, the big one being, of course, Taylor Swift.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，其中最大的例子当然就是泰勒·斯威夫特。

sentences.en: They say, you know, we're the ones singing, we're the ones in front of the microphone, and shouldn't it be ours?
sentences.zh: 他们说，你知道的，唱歌的是我们，站在麦克风前的是我们，难道不应该属于我们吗？

sentences.en: And in other conversations, I've heard you say that you regret not owning the One Direction name.
sentences.zh: 在其他访谈中，我听你说过，你后悔没有拥有“单向乐队”这个名字。

sentences.en: I'm wondering how you just sort of square that.
sentences.zh: 我想知道你是怎么看待这个问题的。

sentences.en: I think it depends on the circumstances, if I'm being honest with you.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我觉得这要看具体情况。

sentences.en: I think if a band have formed themselves, and they come to me, say, and just say, look, we want funding, and, you know, you to be the label, like I used to do.
sentences.zh: 我觉得如果一个乐队是自己组建的，然后他们来找我，比方说，只是说，听着，我们需要资金，希望你当唱片公司，就像我以前做的那样。

sentences.en: I get it.
sentences.zh: 我懂。

sentences.en: They did it.
sentences.zh: 那是他们做到的。

sentences.en: If I was part of putting everything together, it's almost like you're part of the band.
sentences.zh: 如果我参与了所有事情的筹备，那就感觉你好像也是乐队的一部分。

sentences.en: You know, over the years, there have been complaints about contracts with artists, and yours, especially as pertains to X Factor,
sentences.zh: 你知道的，多年来一直有人抱怨与艺术家的合同，特别是关于《X音素》的合同，

sentences.en: where some artists said they actually didn't make any money when they signed with your company because of low royalty rates.
sentences.zh: 当时有些艺术家表示，由于版税比例很低，他们签约你的公司后实际上根本没赚到什么钱。

sentences.en: And I'm just wondering if you think the contracts were all fair.
sentences.zh: 我只是想知道你是否认为这些合同都是公平的。

sentences.en: Is there a way that you look at it in terms of being a business person and in terms of being someone who is creating and supporting artists?
sentences.zh: 从商人的角度，以及从一个创作和支持艺术家的角色的角度来看，你有什么看法吗？

sentences.en: Well, I didn't really get involved in those negotiations.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我其实并没有参与那些谈判。

sentences.en: If you ask me what anyone's royalty was, I actually couldn't tell you, Lulu.
sentences.zh: 如果你问我任何人的版税是多少，露露，我真的说不出来。

sentences.en: Genuinely.
sentences.zh: 真的。

sentences.en: I mean, look, I think I would have to look.
sentences.zh: 我是说，听着，我想我得去查查。

sentences.en: I guess you'd have to talk to both sides, I suppose, the people who are happy and unhappy.
sentences.zh: 我想你得跟双方聊聊吧，我是说那些满意的人和不满意的人。

sentences.en: I mean, some people were happy.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，有些人是满意的。

sentences.en: I guess some people were unhappy.
sentences.zh: 我想有些人是不满意的。

sentences.en: I mean, that's life, I guess.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，生活就是这样吧。

sentences.en: But I think, I don't think it was unfair, Lulu, no.
sentences.zh: 但我觉得，这并不算不公平，露露，真的不是。

sentences.en: Okay, I want to talk about your personal life.
sentences.zh: 好的，我想谈谈你的个人生活。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: I was reading your authorized biography, which came out in 2012, and it made it pretty clear that you used to party pretty hard when you were younger.
sentences.zh: 我读了你的授权传记，那是 2012 年出版的，书中非常明确地指出，你年轻时玩得很疯。

sentences.en: You were famously adverse to commitment.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你很抗拒安定下来。

sentences.en: You know, you were a man about town.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你曾是个风流人物。

sentences.en: There were a lot of different partnerships.
sentences.zh: 有过很多不同的交往对象。

sentences.en: Do you think that that was a fair characterization of who you were back then?
sentences.zh: 你认为这是对你当年真实写照的公正评价吗？

sentences.en: Well, yeah, I mean, I had quite a lot of long-term, you know, relationships.
sentences.zh: 嗯，对，我的意思是，我有过相当多的长期恋爱关系，你知道的。

sentences.en: You know, most of my relationships have been pretty long.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我的大部分恋爱关系都维持了相当长的时间。

sentences.en: I'm still friends with a lot of my ex-girlfriends.
sentences.zh: 我和很多前女友至今仍是朋友。

sentences.en: I mean, genuinely.
sentences.zh: 我是说，真的。

sentences.en: The book makes the point that surprisingly, yeah, that you don't really...
sentences.zh: 书里指出，出人意料的是，嗯，你其实……

sentences.en: Can I be honest with you, Lulu?
sentences.zh: 我能跟你说实话吗，露露？

sentences.en: I haven't read it.
sentences.zh: 我没读过那本书。

sentences.en: Oh, wow.
sentences.zh: 噢，哇。

sentences.en: Well...
sentences.zh: 好吧……

sentences.en: So you know more than I do.
sentences.zh: 所以你比我知道得还多。

sentences.en: Yeah, but it does make the point that your exes are friends of yours, but it does also make the point that back then you were, you know, a man about town.
sentences.zh: 对，但书里确实提到你的前任都是你的朋友，但它也指出当年你是个，你知道的，风流人物。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 对，对。

sentences.en: Yeah, probably.
sentences.zh: 对，大概是吧。

sentences.en: So you're now part of this family unit.
sentences.zh: 所以你现在是这个家庭的一员了。

sentences.en: You have a long-term partner, Lauren, and your son now, Eric.
sentences.zh: 你有一个长期的伴侣劳伦，还有一个儿子埃里克。

sentences.en: How has that changed you?
sentences.zh: 这怎么改变了你？

sentences.en: Well, it saved me, if I'm being honest with you, Lulu.
sentences.zh: 嗯，老实说，露露，这拯救了我。

sentences.en: When my mum passed away in 2015, after losing my dad and then losing my mum, it was like feeling like an orphan, genuinely.
sentences.zh: 当我的妈妈在 2015 年去世时，在失去了父亲又失去母亲之后，那种感觉就像是成了一个孤儿，真的。

sentences.en: And thank God, my mum, you know, even though she had dementia and it was getting pretty bad, she, you know, she met Eric.
sentences.zh: 谢天谢地，我妈妈，你知道的，尽管她患有痴呆症而且病情越来越重，她，你知道的，她见到了埃里克。

sentences.en: And, you know, what is amazing.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，这太神奇了。

sentences.en: And he remembers her vaguely because he was really young.
sentences.zh: 而且他模模糊糊地还记得她，因为他当时太小了。

sentences.en: And my mum gave him this brown blanket, you know, just probably about three or four feet long.
sentences.zh: 我妈妈给了他这条棕色的毯子，你知道的，大概有三四英尺长吧。

sentences.en: And to this day, he will not go anywhere without that brown blanket.
sentences.zh: 直到今天，他去哪里都要带着那条棕色的毯子。

sentences.en: Your son, Eric, was a major turning point, as you mentioned.
sentences.zh: 正如你所提到的，你的儿子埃里克是一个重大的转折点。

sentences.en: And you've described it as sort of pulling you out of this very dark downward spiral that you were on after your mother died.
sentences.zh: 你曾形容这就像是将你从母亲去世后陷入的那个非常黑暗的向下沉沦的漩涡中拉了出来。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: I just, I don't know, I always had suffered from depression.
sentences.zh: 我只是，我不知道，我一直饱受抑郁症的折磨。

sentences.en: And I got to a point where, you know, life, my career was going great.
sentences.zh: 我曾达到这样一个阶段，你知道的，生活、我的事业都进展顺利。

sentences.en: But for whatever reason, I was just unhappy, just really unhappy.
sentences.zh: 但不管出于什么原因，我就是不开心，真的非常不开心。

sentences.en: Um, and, um, you know, that expression, is this as good as it gets?
sentences.zh: 嗯，而且，你知道的，有句话叫“生活也就这样了吧”？

sentences.en: I was kind of feeling a bit like that, actually.
sentences.zh: 其实我当时差不多就是这种感觉。

sentences.en: It was kind of like everything just felt monotonous.
sentences.zh: 就感觉一切都单调乏味。

sentences.en: Um, and that was sort of it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，差不多就是这样。

sentences.en: And then, you know, he kind of like, it was like my life changed when he was born.
sentences.zh: 然后，你知道的，他某种程度上就像是，我的人生在他出生时改变了。

sentences.en: Everything started again, if that kind of makes sense.
sentences.zh: 一切都重新开始，如果这种说法讲得通的话。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, what does it look like exactly to sort of pull yourself out of that?
sentences.zh: 对，我的意思是，把自己从那种状态中拉出来具体是什么样的？

sentences.en: I mean, what did you do, practically speaking, to get yourself into a different place?
sentences.zh: 我是说，从实际角度出发，你做了什么来让自己进入一种不同的状态？

sentences.en: Well, I used to work genuinely up until sometimes seven in the morning.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我以前真的经常工作到有时早上七点。

sentences.en: Um, there was always stuff to do.
sentences.zh: 嗯，总是有做不完的事。

sentences.en: And I found it, that time, from like one to seven in the morning, weirdly peaceful.
sentences.zh: 而且我发现，从凌晨一点到早上七点这段时间，有一种奇怪的平静。

sentences.en: Uh, I could really focus on the shows, you know, whatever we were doing, if we were, you know, listening to songs.
sentences.zh: 呃，我可以真正专注于节目，你知道的，无论我们在做什么，如果我们，你知道的，在听歌的话。

sentences.en: There was always something, right?
sentences.zh: 总是有各种事情，对吧？

sentences.en: And then, um, when Eric was about two, uh, he must have been about that age, because I didn't get up until the afternoon.
sentences.zh: 然后，呃，当埃里克大约两岁的时候，呃，他当时肯定也就是那个年纪，因为我直到下午才起床。

sentences.en: So I never saw the morning.
sentences.zh: 所以我从来没见过早晨。

sentences.en: I hadn't seen the morning for years.
sentences.zh: 我已经好几年没见过早晨了。

sentences.en: I actually used to think, God, how could people work in the morning?
sentences.zh: 我以前甚至会想，天哪，怎么有人能在早晨工作？

sentences.en: It just felt weird to me.
sentences.zh: 这对我来说感觉太怪了。

sentences.en: And, um, he came in one day, and it was about 2.30 in the afternoon, and he went, Dad, what are you, what are you doing asleep?
sentences.zh: 然后，呃，有一天他走了进来，大约是下午两点半，他说，爸爸，你，你在睡觉干嘛呢？

sentences.en: And I went, God, he's right.
sentences.zh: 然后我说，天哪，他说得对。

sentences.en: What am I doing asleep?
sentences.zh: 我睡觉到底在干嘛？

sentences.en: I've got to readjuSt.
sentences.zh: 我得调整一下了。

sentences.en: You know, Simon, it does appear that you've sort of softened.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，西蒙，看起来你确实变得温和了。

sentences.en: Would you say that that's an accurate reflection of how you see yourself at the moment?
sentences.zh: 你觉得这准确反映了你眼下的自我认知吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I would say that, yeah, for sure.
sentences.zh: 对，我会这么说，对，肯定的。

sentences.en: I'm, I'm, I'm more, I think more confident in myself now, you know, like we spoke about yesterday.
sentences.zh: 我，我，我觉得我现在对自己更有信心了，你知道的，就像我们昨天聊的那样。

sentences.en: I'm not afraid to take on new things.
sentences.zh: 我不怕接受新事物。

sentences.en: I like trying new things still.
sentences.zh: 我依然喜欢尝试新事物。

sentences.en: I'm very curious.
sentences.zh: 我很好奇。

sentences.en: You know, when you mentioned the AI, I was thinking about this overnight, the AI thing.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，当你提到人工智能时，我整晚都在思考这个，关于人工智能的事。

sentences.en: I was kind of thinking, is this smart, or is it exploiting people, what they've done?
sentences.zh: 我当时在想，这到底是聪明的，还是在剥削人们已经做过的工作？

sentences.en: I actually don't know the answer to that question.
sentences.zh: 我其实不知道这个问题的答案。

sentences.en: I really, really don't.
sentences.zh: 我是真的、真的不知道。

sentences.en: And the fact that it's happened is a little bit scary.
sentences.zh: 而且它已经发生了这一事实让人有点害怕。

sentences.en: At the same time, I'm sort of intrigued by it.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，我又对它有点着迷。

sentences.en: I don't know how you feel about it.
sentences.zh: 我不知道你是怎么看的。

sentences.en: Well, I don't know either.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我也不知道。

sentences.en: I find AI scary, mostly, and exploitative, mostly.
sentences.zh: 我发现人工智能大多令人害怕，而且大多具有剥削性。

sentences.en: Can I ask you a question?
sentences.zh: 我能问你个问题吗？

sentences.en: If you could have a button, green or red, green being yes, red being no, and you were able to stop the internet, what would you have done?
sentences.zh: 如果你能拥有一个按钮，绿色或红色，绿色代表是，红色代表否，并且你能够按停互联网，你会怎么做？

sentences.en: Oh, God.
sentences.zh: 噢，天哪。

sentences.en: Oh, that's a good question.
sentences.zh: 噢，真是个好问题。

sentences.en: Stop the internet.
sentences.zh: 停掉互联网。

sentences.en: I guess knowing now what we know, you know, the internet has become an extraordinary tool for advancement, but we're sort of petri dishes in a way.
sentences.zh: 我想，以我们现在的了解，你知道的，互联网已经成为一项促进发展的非凡工具，但某种程度上我们就像是培养皿里的细菌。

sentences.en: We're being experimented on in ways that are changing us fundamentally.
sentences.zh: 我们正以从根本上改变我们的方式被实验着。

sentences.en: And I don't know the end of that story yet.
sentences.zh: 而且我还不知道这个故事的结局是什么。

sentences.en: So I don't know.
sentences.zh: 所以我不知道。

sentences.en: What about you?
sentences.zh: 你呢？

sentences.en: It would be stop.
sentences.zh: 我会停掉它。

sentences.en: I press the red button.
sentences.zh: 我会按下红色的按钮。

sentences.en: Because, you know, I just, I was thinking about this the other night, weirdly.
sentences.zh: 因为，你知道的，我只是，前天晚上不知怎的想到了这个。

sentences.en: It was kind of like, I like the time when we didn't have so much choice.
sentences.zh: 就好像，我怀念那个我们没有那么多选择的时代。

sentences.en: So when something came out, like, I don't know, Jaws or Star Wars or whatever, it was such a big deal.
sentences.zh: 所以当有什么作品问世时，比如，我不知道，《大白鲨》或《星球大战》之类的时候，那可是一件了不起的大事。

sentences.en: And the fact that we knew it was coming and we had to go somewhere to watch it, it was such a fun, amazing time.
sentences.zh: 而且我们知道它即将上映、必须去某个地方观看这一事实，是一段多么有趣、美妙的时光。

sentences.en: And I personally think that people were happier then than now.
sentences.zh: 我个人认为，那时候的人们比现在更快乐。

sentences.en: I mean, a lot of people would disagree with that, but that's how I feel.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，很多人可能不同意这一点，但这就是我的感受。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: It's just a personal thing.
sentences.zh: 这只是个人的看法。

sentences.en: I was just curious what you would say.
sentences.zh: 我只是好奇你会怎么说。

sentences.en: Your answer is more interesting, for sure.
sentences.zh: 你的回答显然更有趣。

sentences.en: Just in our last few minutes, as I was sort of mentioning, you've softened.
sentences.zh: 就在我们聊到最后的这几分钟里，正如我刚才提到的，你变得温和了。

sentences.en: And I wonder what you make of the fact that the rest of the world has gotten sort of more vicious.
sentences.zh: 我想知道，对于世界上其他人变得越来越刻薄这一点，你怎么看？

sentences.en: Because we see it in our culture, we see it in our politics.
sentences.zh: 因为我们在我们的文化中看到了这一点，在我们的政治中也看到了这一点。

sentences.en: As someone who understood the power of the bully, that it can rally people, that you were the most popular member of the panel in all these shows because you told it like it was.
sentences.zh: 作为一个深谙恶霸力量之道的人——知道它能凝聚人心，而且因为你有什么说什么，曾是所有这些节目中最受欢迎的嘉宾——

sentences.en: Does any of your experience with that give you insight on this moment?
sentences.zh: 你过去的任何相关经验，是否能让你对当下这个时代有更深的理解？

sentences.en: Well, I think if we're talking about what I wish, then I wish, you know, when we make Got Talent, we all say the same thing to each other, which is,
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想如果我们谈论的是我的愿望，那我希望，你知道，当我们制作《达人秀》时，大家都会互相说同样的一句话，那就是，

sentences.en: this is just how everything should be.
sentences.zh: 这才是万物应有的模样。

sentences.en: We all get on well with each other, you know, genuinely.
sentences.zh: 我们彼此相处得很好，你知道，是发自内心地好。

sentences.en: Everyone's welcome.
sentences.zh: 欢迎每一个人。

sentences.en: Everyone has a great time, a great experience.
sentences.zh: 每个人都过得很开心，拥有美好的体验。

sentences.en: I mean, you sat there and you experienced it, you know.
sentences.zh: 我是说，你当时就坐在那里，你亲身体验过，你知道的。

sentences.en: I was thinking about that, the fact that you saw it.
sentences.zh: 我一直在想那件事，就是你亲眼见证的那一幕。

sentences.en: And then you kind of go, that's a great bubble to live in.
sentences.zh: 然后你就会觉得，生活在一个这样美好的泡沫里真好。

sentences.en: So I sort of live in a slight bubble, if I'm being honest with you,
sentences.zh: 所以说句实话，我的生活其实也略带一点泡沫感，

sentences.en: in so much as because I don't have a phone and I don't read anything online or I don't read newspapers.
sentences.zh: 因为我没有手机，不看任何网上的东西，也不读报纸。

sentences.en: You don't watch TikTok, Instagram, nothing.
sentences.zh: 你不看TikTok，不看Instagram，什么都不看。

sentences.en: No, I don't, nothing.
sentences.zh: 对，我不看，什么都不看。

sentences.en: I have no idea even what social media things I have.
sentences.zh: 我甚至不知道自己到底有哪些社交媒体账号。

sentences.en: I'm really genuinely oblivious.
sentences.zh: 我是真的完全一无所知。

sentences.en: And I do it for a reason because I'm happier that way.
sentences.zh: 我这样做是有原因的，因为那样我更快乐。

sentences.en: You know, it's my choice.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这是我的选择。

sentences.en: And it's just I decided that's how I wanted to live.
sentences.zh: 这只是我决定了这就是我想过的生活。

sentences.en: And when you asked me about, you know, being softer now, I think maybe that's part of the reason is that I just don't get caught up in anything, you know.
sentences.zh: 当你问我，你知道的，为什么我现在变得更温和了，我想这也许就是部分原因——我只是不卷入任何事情，你知道的。

sentences.en: So I don't want to change that.
sentences.zh: 所以我不想改变这一点。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Before we go, I want to get your take on a few things.
sentences.zh: 在我们结束之前，我想听听你对几件事的看法。

sentences.en: Who is your favorite current artist who has nothing to do with you?
sentences.zh: 你现在最喜欢的、和你没有任何关系的歌手是谁？

sentences.en: Chapel.
sentences.zh: 查佩尔。

sentences.en: Roan.
sentences.zh: 罗恩。

sentences.en: Roan.
sentences.zh: 罗恩。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: She's great.
sentences.zh: 她太棒了。

sentences.en: Yeah, I heard her first song, Eric played it to me and I went, that is one of the best, best songs I've heard in years.
sentences.zh: 对，我听过她的第一首歌，埃里克放给我听的，当时我就想，这是我多年来听过的最棒、最棒的歌曲之一。

sentences.en: Do you watch reality TV?
sentences.zh: 你看真人秀电视节目吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不看。

sentences.en: Are you a housewives guy?
sentences.zh: 你是《娇妻》系列的粉丝吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不是。

sentences.en: Would you go on Traitors, Celebrity Traitors?
sentences.zh: 你会去参加《叛徒》或《名人叛徒》吗？

sentences.en: Never.
sentences.zh: 绝不。

sentences.en: Never.
sentences.zh: 绝不。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: You've said before that you wanted to be cryogenically frozen.
sentences.zh: 你以前说过你想被冷冻保存。

sentences.en: Is that still true?
sentences.zh: 现在还是这样吗？

sentences.en: Because the technology has gotten a lot better.
sentences.zh: 因为现在的技术已经进步很多了。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: I'll tell you a funny story.
sentences.zh: 我给你讲个有趣的故事。

sentences.en: So, yes, I did think for a while, okay, well, we're all going to eventually, unfortunately, die.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我确实有一段时间想过，好吧，不幸的是，我们大家最终都会死。

sentences.en: That's life.
sentences.zh: 这就是生活。

sentences.en: What if then I'll just freeze myself?
sentences.zh: 那如果我把自己冷冻起来会怎么样？

sentences.en: That was before, by the way, I was, you know, a dad.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，那是在我成为父亲之前。

sentences.en: Then someone told me, they chop your head off.
sentences.zh: 然后有人告诉我，他们会把你的头砍下来。

sentences.en: And then basically, I think your brain's frozen.
sentences.zh: 基本上，我觉得然后你的大脑就被冷冻了。

sentences.en: So then the idea of coming back as some kind of robot in 3,000 years' time, it's like, forget it.
sentences.zh: 所以一想到三千年后以某种机器人的形态复活，我就觉得：算了吧。

sentences.en: No, I'm not interested.
sentences.zh: 不，我没兴趣。

sentences.en: Even if it's your full body now, not just the head?
sentences.zh: 即使现在是整个人体冷冻，而不只是切下头部呢？

sentences.en: No, no, I don't want to.
sentences.zh: 不，不，我不想。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: Maybe, I actually do believe, I think now, I do believe in God.
sentences.zh: 也许吧，其实我现在真的相信，我想现在我是相信上帝的。

sentences.en: And I do believe there's something, I really do hope and believe that there's something good that happens afterwards.
sentences.zh: 而且我确实相信冥冥之中自有安排，我真的由衷地希望并相信死后会有美好的事情发生。

sentences.en: I don't know what it is.
sentences.zh: 我不知道那是什么。

sentences.en: I always think about the power of the universe and how little we know about that.
sentences.zh: 我总是想起宇宙的力量，以及我们对它了解得是多么少。

sentences.en: And it's kind of that unknown.
sentences.zh: 这就是那种未知的美妙。

sentences.en: And my mom had a lot of faith, which, you know, was really genuinely made her happy.
sentences.zh: 我妈妈有着坚定的信仰，你知道的，这确实让她由衷地感到快乐。

sentences.en: And I started to think a lot about that, not because I'm getting older or I'm going to die tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我开始经常思考这个问题，并不是因为我变老了或者我明天就要死了。

sentences.en: It's just, does it make me happy?
sentences.zh: 只是想，这能让我快乐吗？

sentences.en: Actually, yes, it does.
sentences.zh: 事实上，是的，确实能。

sentences.zh: 西蒙·考威尔，这次谈话非常愉快。

sentences.en: Thank you so very, very much.
sentences.zh: 非常非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you for saying that.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你这么说。

sentences.en: I have really, really enjoyed this, Lulu.
sentences.zh: 露露，我真的、真的很享受这次谈话。

sentences.en: It's been a real pleasure to talk to and thank you.
sentences.zh: 能和你交流是一件非常愉快的事，谢谢你。
